consequence.statement: Clusters with JMX enabled now use JVM defaults instead of the implicit IPv4 preference, so they boot up correctly in IPv6-only environments where the IPv4 preference previously broke the boot up.

assertion.statement: The implicit IPv4 preference that was applied when JMX is enabled has been removed in Strimzi 0.46.0, so JMX-enabled clusters now use JVM defaults and boot up correctly in IPv6-only environments.

checks.detail: no canonical exposure condition for protocol-behavior removed
